description: This file defines the 'BuzzComment' entity class for a human resource management system, using Doctrine ORM mappings. It includes properties like id, share, employee, number of likes, comment text, creation and update timestamps, and associated getter/setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment on a Buzz share, with ORM mappings, properties for comment details, and methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the comment.

methods.name: getShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzShare entity the comment belongs to.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with this comment.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who made the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who made the comment.

methods.name: getNumOfLikes
methods.description: Returns the number of likes for this comment.

methods.name: setNumOfLikes
methods.description: Sets the number of likes for this comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp to current UTC time.
